title: The Unholy Glory of Parasitoids
content: The New York Times Magazine has a column called Letter of Recommendation, which it describes as “Celebrating the overlooked and underappreciated.” Championing what many people disregard is something of my raison d’etre, and the same could probably be said for many entomologists. While some of the entries (e.g., why having a middle seat on an airplane can be a transformative experience) left me cold, one of them (Leonard 2024) resonated with me. It was about parasitoids.
